ideas.pitch: An autonomous multi-agent stock analysis system that pits a bull thesis agent against a fierce bear thesis agent to evaluate NSE-listed equities.
ideas.title: Adversarial Equity Researcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the multi-agent thesis falsification pattern from Should-AI-Buy, providing judges with robust, stress-tested financial reports rather than simple optimistic AI summaries.

ideas.pitch: An automated AML risk detection platform for Indian banking transactions combining graph neural networks and explainable decision trees to catch circular trading.
ideas.title: FraudGraph India
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors the winning architecture of Bito by applying graph intelligence to transaction data, making it immensely attractive for the risk and fraud analytics track.

ideas.pitch: A real-time financial forecasting engine that ingests RBI repo rates, CPI inflation prints, and IIP data to predict sectoral index movements on the NSE.
ideas.title: MacroPulse India
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on hard macroeconomic indicators specific to the Indian market, ensuring relevance to the judges looking for practical quantitative forecasting tools.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered financial advisory agent equipped with deterministic risk gates and strict asset allocation caps tailored for retail Indian investors.
ideas.title: WealthGuard AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Integrates hard risk boundaries just like the Alpaca hackathon winner, avoiding the typical hallucination pitfalls of standard AI advisors that judges penalize.

ideas.pitch: A risk analytics dashboard that parses SEBI bulk and block deal disclosures to score corporate governance risks and unusual trading patterns.
ideas.title: InsiderWatch
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses unique, publicly available regulatory filings from Indian exchanges that most student teams ignore, standing out through a hard data-ingestion pipeline.
